hook_text: One sports day in Bloemfontein uses every skill from Terms 1 and 2. Can you spot them all?
clip_script: Winter sports day in Bloemfontein. Spectators: 3 586 plus 4 729 is 8 315. 432 learners in teams of 18: 24 teams. 350 bottles in crates of 24: 14 full crates, so 15 to pack them all. Half-time oranges in quarters: 3/4 plus 2/4 is 1 and 1/4. 3/4 of a team of 24 is 18. Cones stacked 1, 3, 6, 10, then 15. Points rule: times 5, minus 2. The field is a rectangle with 2 lines of symmetry, not 4. Estimate first, check with the opposite.
visual_style: A sports field map with each area labelled by the skill it uses, ticking off one by one.
mood: Energetic and proud, like a school cheering on the final relay.
pacing: Rapid tour from the gate to half-time to the field, one skill per beat.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and do one practice question from every topic.
